ecology_event_rate_fit.quantity: events per tick over the first 8 ticks

region_gap.assumptions: History growth ignored, so these are lower bounds on time; 256 sites and 8 lineages as measured; a century is 100, 1,200, 5,218 or 36,525 ticks; 300 s stands for a few minutes; fits are the top-three-size fits on first-8-tick means.
